title: CCTV shows last sighting of Noah Woods
description: Suffolk Police released CCTV of the last confirmed sighting of Noah in the park in Brantham at 14:37 BST on Tuesday.

title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
description: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.

title: Petrol and diesel price rises push UK inflation higher
description: Summer holidays and disruption to global oil supplies by the Middle East conflict stoked price growth.

title: How being music's Mr Nice Guy contributed to biggest crisis of Ed Sheeran's career
description: Sheeran tries to stay away from politics and controversy, but that stance has come in for criticism.

title: Earl Spencer's unreleased book on sister Diana stolen in the Netherlands
description: The theft of Earl Spencer's memoir about his late sister comes one week ahead of the book's release.

title: Village votes to leave UK over asylum housing plan in symbolic referendum
description: Piddington residents vote over proposals to house up to 1,256 male asylum seekers nearby.

title: Microsoft says AI rival Anthropic could have 'disastrous impact' on humanity
description: Mustafa Suleyman says he believes the AI giant is in effect teaching Claude it "may be conscious".

title: Author and critic Bonnie Greer dies aged 77
description: Her husband says the playwright and cultural and political commentator died after a brief illness.

title: Burnham rejects 'tax and spend socialist' comments
description: The prime minister insists he is prepared to take "difficult decisions" at next month's Budget.
